mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_order (order_no, user_id, employee_id, pet_id, service_id, service_type, appointment_start_time, appointment_end_time, actual_start_time, actual_end_time, amount, status, payment_status, payment_method, payment_time, transaction_id, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{employeeId}, #{petId}, #{serviceId}, #{serviceType}, #{appointmentStartTime}, #{appointmentEndTime}, #{actualStartTime}, #{actualEndTime}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{paymentStatus}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentTime}, #{transactionId}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT so.id AS 'id', so.order_no AS '订单编号', so.status AS '订单状态', so.amount AS '订单金额', u.real_name AS '客户姓名', u.username AS '客户账号', p.pet_name AS '宠物名称', p.pet_type AS '宠物类型', si.service_name AS '服务项目', so.service_type AS '服务类型', so.appointment_start_time AS '预约时间', so.actual_start_time AS '服务开始时间', so.actual_end_time AS '服务结束时间', so.payment_time AS '支付时间', so.create_time AS '下单时间', so.payment_status AS '支付状态', so.payment_method AS '支付方式' FROM service_order so LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON so.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN pet_info p ON so.pet_id = p.id LEFT JOIN service_item si ON so.service_id = si.id ORDER BY so.create_time DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT so.id, so.order_no, so.service_type, so.appointment_start_time, so.appointment_end_time, so.actual_start_time, so.actual_end_time, so.amount, so.status, so.payment_status, so.payment_method, so.payment_time, so.transaction_id, so.remark, so.create_time, so.update_time, su.id as userId, su.username, su.real_name, su.phone, su.avatar as userAvatar, su.sex as userSex, su.email as userEmail, su.role as userRole, pi.id as petId, pi.pet_name as petName, pi.pet_type as petType, pi.breed as petBreed, pi.avatar as petImage, pi.gender as petGender, pi.birth_date as petBirthDate, pi.weight as petWeight, pi.health_status as petHealthStatus, pi.allergies as petAllergies, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pi.birth_date, CURDATE()) as petAge, si.id as serviceId, si.service_name as serviceName, si.medical_type, si.category as serviceCategory, si.description as serviceDescription, si.image_url as serviceImage, si.price as servicePrice, si.duration as serviceDuration, si.status as serviceStatus FROM service_order so LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON so.user_id = su.id LEFT JOIN pet_info pi ON so.pet_id = pi.id LEFT JOIN service_item si ON so.service_id = si.id WHERE so.id = #{orderId}

su.id = #{userId} AND ( so.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR si.service_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pi.pet_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR si.category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT so.id, so.order_no, so.service_type, so.appointment_start_time, so.appointment_end_time, so.actual_start_time, so.actual_end_time, so.amount, so.status, so.payment_status, so.payment_method, so.payment_time, so.transaction_id, so.remark, so.create_time, so.update_time, su.id as userId, su.username, su.real_name, su.phone, su.avatar as userAvatar, su.sex as userSex, su.email as userEmail, su.role as userRole, pi.id as petId, pi.pet_name as petName, pi.pet_type as petType, pi.breed as petBreed, pi.avatar as petImage, pi.gender as petGender, pi.birth_date as petBirthDate, pi.weight as petWeight, pi.health_status as petHealthStatus, pi.allergies as petAllergies, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, pi.birth_date, CURDATE()) as petAge, si.id as serviceId, si.service_name as serviceName, si.medical_type, si.category as serviceCategory, si.description as serviceDescription, si.image_url as serviceImage, si.price as servicePrice, si.duration as serviceDuration, si.status as serviceStatus FROM service_order so LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON so.user_id = su.id LEFT JOIN pet_info pi ON so.pet_id = pi.id LEFT JOIN service_item si ON so.service_id = si.id WHERE so.status = #{status} or so.status = 'processing'
